concerns.text: The term “representative set” in FR-001 is not defined or tied to a measurable criterion, making it impossible to verify whether the identified repositories satisfy the requirement.
FR-001 uses the word “sufficient” when expanding the search but does not specify a concrete target number or statistical property, leaving the success condition unmeasurable.
FR-004 mentions “a defined observation window” without specifying its length (e.g., six months), so the window cannot be instantiated for testing.

SC-002 states that the median code churn is “measured against the baseline expectation of no difference” but does not define the statistical test, significance threshold, or decision rule, rendering the criterion vague.
SC-003 similarly lacks a concrete test or threshold for comparing median bug‑fix latency, making it unclear how success will be judged.
